meanings.meaning: (uncountable, countable) Extreme aversion or detestation; the feeling of utter dislike or loathing.
examples: The concept of abhorrence is often discussed in this specific academic context.
Many studies have focused on the significance of abhorrence.

meanings.meaning: (countable) A person or thing that is loathsome; a detested thing.
examples: The concept of abhorrence is often discussed in this specific academic context.
Many studies have focused on the significance of abhorrence.

meanings.meaning: (countable, obsolete, historical) An expression of abhorrence, in particular any of the parliamentary addresses dictated towards Charles II.
examples: The concept of abhorrence is often discussed in this specific academic context.
Many studies have focused on the significance of abhorrence.
